title: Extension health across VMs
description: Monitors VM extension status to catch failed deployments or stuck provisioning that blocks updates and monitoring.
example_prompt: "Check all VM extensions across subscriptions. Identify: (1) extensions in 'Failed' provisioning state, (2) extensions in 'Transitioning' state for > 1 hour, (3) extensions with handler status errors, (4) VMs with conflicting extensions. Show VM name, extension, status, and error message."
